content.short: MathWallet is a multichain wallet and dapp browser supporting 200+ blockchains and broad Web3 access.
content.description: MathWallet is a long-running multichain wallet for users who need one app across many ecosystems. It supports dapp discovery, asset storage, transfers, and access to more than 200 blockchains, making TON one part of a wider wallet environment. Find your dApps on more than 200+ blockchains including Ethereum, BNBChain, Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP, Cosmos, Polkadot, Filecoin etc. For TON users, MathWallet is about account access and everyday fund management rather than liquidity routing or analytics.
